description: Download a Google Drive file to a local path. For Google Workspace files (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drawings), exports to the specified format. For regular files, downloads as-is. Streams directly to disk.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

exportMimeType.description: For Google Workspace files: MIME type to export as (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'text/csv'). Auto-detected from file extension if omitted. Ignored for non-Workspace files.

localPath.description: Absolute local path to save the file (must start with /). Can be a directory (filename auto-resolved from Drive metadata) or a full file path. Path is normalized before use.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite if file already exists at localPath. When false (default), returns an error instead of replacing the file.

name: downloadFile
